en.html:
Kageaki"Just now, over there, a child died."
Kageaki"You remember him? The boy from that cafe..."
Kageaki"The boy you explained justice to."
Kageaki"One stone in his hand. With that he challenged the Occupation troops who killed his parents. Braver than anybody in this world. Without even knowing what courage meant."
Kageaki"And... as was only to be expected, he died."
Ichijou"................................"
Kageaki"Ichijou. One more time I will say it. This is the last."
Kageaki"You believe in justice and fight—I will not stop that. But this word 'justice' you are using to decorate the fighting, stop that."
Kageaki"So the ugly truth of fighting is not hidden. So one fight does not give birth to the next."

ja.html:
景明「今、そこで子供が死んだ」
景明「覚えているか。 　あの喫茶店にいた男児だ……」
景明「お前が正義を語って聞かせた彼だ」
景明「彼は両親の命を奪った進駐軍に、石一つを 手にして挑んだ。この世の誰よりも勇敢に。 　勇気の意味も知らずに」
景明「そして……当たり前のように死んだ」
一条「……………………」
景明「一条。あと一度だけ言う。 　これで最後だ」
景明「正義を信じて戦う事は止めない。 　だが、戦いに正義の二字を飾る・・のは止めろ」
景明「戦いというものの醜い真相を隠さない為に。 　その戦いに次ぐ戦いを引き起こさない為に」

en.html:
Ichijou"What you're saying is right."
Ichijou"Fighting is ugly killing on both sides. Bas. Justice is not the name for it."
Ichijou"To keep calling it justice, to take other people along and keep fighting... surely that is the lowest evil. Never forgivable. Even so—"
Kageaki"............"
Ichijou"I, Ichijou Ayane, will hold up justice and fight! Under that word, I will strike down evil!"
Ichijou"And I believe there is a right world at the end of it. A world without fighting."

And so it swore: expose the ugliness. Make people see it.
